articles.summary: SAN JOSE, CA / ACCESS Newswire / October 7, 2026 / Avidbank Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:AVBH) ("Avidbank Holdings") announced today that it will release third quarter 2026 earnings results on Monday, October 26, 2026, after the market closes. Upon release, investors may access a copy of the earnings results on the Avidbank website at www.avidbank.com under About Us, Investor Relations. Avidbank Holdings will host a conference call on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (EDT) / 8:00 a.m. (PDT) to discuss its third quarter 2026 results. Investors may call in by dialing (833) 461-5787 within the US and +1 (585) 542-9983 for all other locations. The conference ID number is 530 848 984. Participants may also pre-register for the conference by navigating to https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/530848984 . Alternatively, individuals may listen to a live webcast of the presentation by visiting the link on Avidbank's website at www.avidbank.com under About Us, Investor Relations. An audio replay
articles.title: Avidbank Holdings, Inc. to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results After-Market on Monday, October 26, 2026
